about_short_description.short_description: Pflege Home Healthcare provides high-quality, compassionate home healthcare.

product.name: Physiotherapy at Home
product.description: Provides physical therapy services at patients' homes to improve mobility, strength, and function through exercises and manual techniques.

product.name: Nurse at Home
product.description: Offers nursing care services at patients' homes by licensed nurses and doctors for medical and personal care needs.

product.name: Doctor at Home
product.description: Delivers medical consultation, assessment, treatment, and diagnostic services at patients' homes by licensed doctors and nurses.

product.name: Lab Tests at Home
product.description: Collects biological samples from patients at home for laboratory testing and delivers results online.

product.name: IV Therapy at Home
product.description: Administers intravenous nutrition therapy at patients' homes to deliver vitamins and minerals directly into the bloodstream.

product.name: RT-PCR Test at Home
product.description: Offers collection of samples for RT-PCR testing at patients' homes with expedited delivery of results.
